create_ant_foraging_game: create an AntForagingGame instance with custom grid size, number of ants, and food sources
build_ant_foraging_state: build an AntForagingState from an AntForagingGame to initialize the grid, nest, food, and ant positions
run_ant_foraging_actions: run legal actions for each ant including move up, down, left, right, or stay on the grid
test_ant_foraging_observer: test the AntForagingObserver to generate observation tensors with grid cells, ant positions, and pheromone channels
review_ant_foraging_phieromones: review the pheromone decay and trail mechanics that ants use to coordinate food foraging on the grid
